description: Find orders first prepared through this assistant connection with history permission, newest first. Replacements inherit their original order’s history access; revising an unlinked order does not add it. Requires a connected buyer who granted orders:read; the public endpoint returns connection instructions. Returns compact order IDs, dates, totals, card counts and payment/refund states, plus next_cursor. Use read_order with a returned order_id for card details and mailing status; no per-order token is needed with history permission. Excludes expired, erased and revoked orders. Reconnecting starts a separate history. Never use names or addresses to find another buyer’s orders.

cursor.description: Exact next_cursor from the previous list_orders result. Omit for the newest page. A cursor grants no access.

limit.description: Maximum orders in this page, from 1 to 50. Omission returns 10, newest first.

name: list_orders
title: List your orders
